title: Relax, Refuel, Repeat: Kroger Helps Dad Kick Back This Father's Day
summary: The Kroger Co. (NYSE: KR) is helping customers celebrate Dad with convenient and delicious summer meal inspiration to make Father's Day memorable. From grilling to gifting, Kroger is helping dads relax and refuel this holiday. "Father's Day is about celebrating the moments that matter most – whether that's firing up the grill, sharing a great meal or simply spending time together," said Mary Ellen Adcock, executive vice president and chief merchant and marketing officer. "At Kroger, we're making it easy to relax, refuel and repeat with ready-to-enjoy meals, simple recipe inspiration and fuel rewards that help families go further while creating meaningful memories." Kick Off the Day with Heart (and Fuel Points) Make the moment meaningful with a heartfelt card and the perfect gift. Kroger offers a wide selection of Father's Day cards featuring a buy 2, save $3 offer until June 21 along with gift cards for restaurants, home improvement and more to match dad's interests.
